package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type learnerOverviewMasteryStub struct {
	items []domain.StudentTargetMastery
	limit int
}

type learnerOverviewJourneyStub struct{}

func (learnerOverviewJourneyStub) GetLearningPath(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (learnerOverviewJourneyStub) GetLatestDiagnosticSnapshot(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	return domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (learnerOverviewJourneyStub) ListRecentLearningSessions(context.Context, string, int) ([]domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (stub *learnerOverviewMasteryStub) ListRecentStudentTargetMastery(_ context.Context, _ string, limit int) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	stub.limit = limit
	return stub.items, nil
}

func TestGetLearnerOverviewIsBoundedAndAllowsMissingOnboarding(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	profiles := &onboardingRepositoryStub{err: domain.ErrNotFound}
	mastery := &learnerOverviewMasteryStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{{
		StudentID: studentID,
		Target:    domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces"},
		State:     domain.TargetMasteryPracticed, FailureCount: 1, EvidenceCount: 1,
		LastSeenAt:    time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 9, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
		PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
	}}}
	result, err := (GetLearnerOverview{Profiles: profiles, Mastery: mastery, Journey: learnerOverviewJourneyStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get learner overview: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Onboarding != nil || len(result.RecentMastery) != 1 || mastery.limit != 20 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected bounded overview: %+v limit=%d", result, mastery.limit)
	}
}
